# Leadsx1B Blog
> Official bilingual blog about B2B prospecting, Google Maps lead generation, WhatsApp sales, and CRM workflows.
> Leadsx1B platform: https://www.leads1xb.pro

The blog is published in English and Portuguese. Article pages are public and can be cited with their canonical URLs.

## Blog indexes
- [English blog](https://blog.leads1xb.pro/blog): Latest English articles.
- [Blog em português](https://blog.leads1xb.pro/pt/blog): Artigos recentes em português.

## English articles
- [How to Prospect on WhatsApp Without Getting Banned: The Ultimate Cold Outreach Guide](https://blog.leads1xb.pro/blog/cold-outreach-whatsapp-sales-guide): Learn essential phone warming rules, smart sending cadence, and battle-tested copywriting formulas to run high-volume WhatsApp outreach safely.
- [How to Extract 1,000+ Verified B2B Leads from Google Maps in Under 10 Minutes with AI](https://blog.leads1xb.pro/blog/google-maps-b2b-lead-generation-ai): Discover the exact blueprint top outbound sales teams use to extract hyper-targeted local business leads from Google Maps, enrich them with AI, and convert them via WhatsApp.
- [The B2B Lead Follow-Up System: How to Turn Cold Leads into Sales with AI and WhatsApp](https://blog.leads1xb.pro/blog/b2b-lead-follow-up-system): Turn cold leads into sales with a 5-stage follow-up system, a respectful WhatsApp cadence, AI personalization, and a connected CRM workflow.
- [How to Build a High-Velocity B2B Sales Pipeline to Close 3x More Deals](https://blog.leads1xb.pro/blog/b2b-sales-pipeline-crm-best-practices): Learn how to structure every stage of your sales funnel, eliminate follow-up friction, and keep your reps laser-focused on top-tier revenue deals.
- [Step-by-Step Tutorial: From Zero to Your First Closed Deal with Leadsx1B in 15 Minutes](https://blog.leads1xb.pro/blog/leadsx1b-complete-step-by-step-tutorial): The complete onboarding guide to configure your workspace, pull high-intent leads from Google Maps, connect WhatsApp, and launch your first outbound campaign.
